primary_candidate.rules: GC, 30m, London 07:00-11:00 Europe/London. Completed 4H close on EMA200 side. Completed 30m close on EMA200 side. EMA20/50/200 stack aligned. Trend-aligned 3-candle FVG. Wait for 50% midpoint interaction. Trident approximation reaction candle whose range contains the midpoint. Enter next 30m open +/- 1 tick. Stop beyond FVG far boundary +/- 1 tick. 2R tracked independently of 1/1.5/3/4/5R. Max 1 trade/day. No new entry at/after 11:00 London. Flatten 15:55 ET. Never average. No VWAP.
